name: mlefree
description: Mat’s Cloud — a real Fidj generator integration and CI fixture

scripts.create:
npm run generator && mkdir -p .gen && cd .gen && npx --no-install yo @ofidj/fidj mleweb --replace --app-id fidj-d204854971e704b9 --api-endpoint https://api.fidj.ovh/v3 --oidc-issuer https://api.fidj.ovh/oidc --sdk-path "${FIDJ_SDK_DIR:-../../../ofidj/fidj-node/dist}" --entry-path "${FIDJ_ENTRY_DIR:-../../../ofidj/fidj-entry/dist}" --title "mlefree.com" --welcome "Welcome to mlefree.com" --description "Projects, notes and experiments by Mat." --content "

Follow the projects I am building and the notes behind them.

About me · Build with Fidj · Follow on Twitter

Email hello@mlefree.com

" --logo ../brand/mario.gif --favicon ../brand/mario.gif --domain mlefree.com --anonymous false --signin both && cd .. && npm install --prefix .gen/mleweb --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build-prod --prefix .gen/mleweb
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs && npm test --prefix .gen/mleweb
